caveats: Requires Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) installed and signed in on the daemon host; built against agy 1.2.9.
No steering, in-app permission prompts, or revert: agy's stream-json mode does not expose them.
Sharing Paseo's MCP tools is opt-in and writes a credential-bearing .agents/mcp_config.json (locally git-excluded).
Verified end to end on macOS only.
